patterns.note: Content sections are organized into flexible grids of cards, often featuring a prominent image or graphic alongside a title and brief description, allowing for varied visual presentation within a consistent structure.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles, contrasting with smaller, lighter text for body content and metadata, and very small, often uppercase labels for categories.

The site uses a predominantly stark white background with black text, punctuated by vibrant, often pastel-toned, abstract or gradient-filled imagery within content cards to add visual interest and delineate content.

The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing persistent access to site navigation, while all other page content scrolls vertically in a standard fashion.

The homepage is structured into distinct, full-width content blocks, each introduced by a clear heading and often a 'View all' link, facilitating easy navigation through different content categories like news, stories, and research.

technique_notes: The page content scrolls vertically in a standard browser fashion. The main navigation bar is a fixed element at the top of the viewport, ensuring it remains visible and accessible regardless of scroll depth. No custom scroll-triggered animations or reveals are used for other page elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and very small, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on cards, buttons, and input fields, contributing to a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but a more compact grid for content cards.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its combination of a very clean, almost stark white, minimal layout with highly abstract, often gradient-filled, and vibrantly colored imagery used within content cards. The initial hero section, featuring a prominent search bar as the primary interaction point, is also an unusual and effective design choice for a homepage.
